native_mechanisms: Grey wax trough where each mark's impression is pressed atop still-warm prior impressions, so no mark is ever read clean — only as a smear of overlapping presses.
Seven tuned insect-swarms biting a dipped wire, each in its own fixed count and rhythm, driven by a forward-only spinning slate wheel so a bite can never be walked off.
A single final plunge into chilling brine that freezes the accumulated bite-pattern into a unique six-flower frost lattice, sketched to tin as the only surviving token.
core_technique: Seven parallel 64-bit accumulators, each fed deliberately overlapping unaligned 8-byte loads (7-byte offsets, 49-byte stride over 50 read bytes) through a per-lane xor-rotate-add-constant ARX round, round-robined over the tail, folded by rotated addition with the length, and finished with the stock splitmix64/Stafford Mix13 avalanche finalizer.
